There are no secrets, URLs or CDN references. The diff under apps/ and packages/ excluding the two files is empty, so the round-2 fixes (packages/db/migrations/0009_business_unit_hierarchy_guard.sql, destination authz, rate-limit keying) are byte-identical to round 3. checks_run.actual: listFilesOnly: apps/web/e2e/journeys.spec.ts and playwright.config.ts. Baseline exit 0. summary: PASS. F-DG1-147 is verified fixed (CLOSED_VERIFIED): apps/web/tsconfig.e2e.json, run by the apps/web typecheck script and so by `pnpm -r typecheck` and CI, type-checks apps/web/e2e/**/*.ts and playwright.config.ts under the strict base config. Injected errors in the spec, in playwright.config.ts and in a Playwright API call each fail with exit 2, and each revert passes. Since round 3 the only change is these two tooling files; the round-2 product fixes are byte-identical. All required checks ran and passed: typecheck, build, lint, openapi, no-cdn, format, unit on Node 22 and 24 (326), integration twice on fresh PG16 (209), gates/agents (105), deploy scripts (59), install-sandbox 13/14 offline (AC-1 effect = D-057 residual), SBOM, DG0 historical, and ci.yml copies identical (live CI = D-058 residual).
